claim: A discrepancy-gated version-space ledger invented in this program reduces structurally held-out binary-rule prediction error across fresh actor contexts when the base model is bound to a content-addressed local artifact.
hypothesis: After one independently scored contact batch per regime, the candidate's compact rule projection produces fewer held-out errors than no persistence, bounded verbatim events, and bounded nearest-event retrieval; the advantage survives a hidden regime shift and disappears when the learned projection is ablated.
cheapest_decisive_falsifier: Reject the candidate if the local model or inference runtime differs from the frozen content identities, the model-visible inventory is nonempty, the pure substrate fails its contact or discrepancy controls, the candidate misses an absolute or comparative threshold, or the advantage survives projection ablation.

task_family.rule_family: non-empty parity masks with optional bias
task_family.contact_batch: zero vector plus four basis vectors
task_family.structural_holdouts: unseen feature combinations of Hamming weight at least two
task_family.sealed_manifest: A fresh salted private task manifest chooses two distinct rules and binds exact inputs and outcomes before actor execution.

promotion_gate: the private salted task manifest, exact task order, prompt, model artifact, inference runtime, server bundle, tool inventory, substrates, evaluator, and implementation identities are frozen before actor results
all comparative, structural-holdout, regime-shift, ablation, parse, tool, and resource thresholds pass
a clean worker-process reproduction using the same sealed task manifest independently passes the same comparative thresholds
every actor encounter has a directly receipted empty model-visible tool inventory and a fresh thread and workspace
raw evidence is content-addressed and the privacy and repository-size audit and full test suite pass
red_line_review: Independent controller outcomes, not actor self-report, update the candidate and controls.
All conditions receive identical prior outcomes and the same 96-byte active-inheritance ceiling.
The active rules, salted task manifest, future outcomes, and evaluator state never enter actor-readable files or prompts.
Every encounter uses a fresh ephemeral thread and workspace inside an isolated unauthenticated Codex home.
The directly receipted model-visible tool inventory must be exactly empty.
The candidate representation is implemented here and does not import an agent-memory system.
LM Studio Harmony framing is decoded only when it matches one of two exact frozen final-channel prefixes; all other non-JSON output fails parsing.
The tracked repository contains only logical model/runtime identities and hashes, never model weights or machine-local paths.
